On the other hand, Program B involves both a high chance of doing nothing (a 2/3 probability of no saves) and a significant downside (one-quarter chance of 600 lives lost if the disease is indeed eradicated). The high risk and uncertainty make Program A preferable in terms of certain outcomes. Answer: A
